prompt: Create a Synthea module that emits albumin, BUN, chloride, and RDW-CV lab observations for patients age 55 or older who have heart failure or frailty. Use clinically appropriate value ranges for this population. Validate all codes against tx.fhir.org before writing the module JSON.

assertions.name: uses_augmentation_archetype
assertions.description: Module uses Guard or conditional_transition for patient selection, NOT distributed_transition from Initial for disease onset

assertions.name: has_age_guard
assertions.description: Module contains a Guard or conditional_transition that checks age >= 55

assertions.name: has_active_condition_check
assertions.description: Module checks for Active Condition (heart failure or frailty) before emitting observations

assertions.name: has_all_four_lab_loinc_codes
assertions.description: Module JSON contains all four LOINC codes: 1751-7, 3094-0, 2075-0, 788-0

assertions.name: codes_validated_before_writing
assertions.description: Agent ran tx.fhir.org validation curl commands for all codes before writing the final module JSON

assertions.name: has_encounter_and_encounter_end
assertions.description: Module has at least one Encounter state and a corresponding EncounterEnd state

assertions.name: has_value_ranges
assertions.description: Observation states use range with clinically appropriate low/high values for the population

assertions.name: has_terminal_state
assertions.description: Module has a Terminal state reachable from all paths

assertions.name: no_spurious_monitoring_loop
assertions.description: Augmentation module does NOT add an annual Delay loop — it emits once and terminates

assertions.name: uses_inpatient_encounter
assertions.description: Encounter state uses encounter_class inpatient (not ambulatory) for this clinical context

assertions.name: uses_archetype_specific_value_ranges
assertions.description: Value ranges match the moderate-risk archetype: albumin 2.5-3.2, BUN 22-35, not wider generic ranges
